Signal Veil - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020814/ 

SIGNAL VEIL is a classic-style psychological survival horror game.

After inheriting her mother’s old phone, Aki begins experiencing supernatural phenomena no one else can see. As her seemingly ordinary school reveals a disturbing past buried beneath false memories and silence, Aki must confront grotesque spirits, impossible messages, and a fractured reality.

Explore tense environments through classic fixed camera angles, use Aki’s phone to detect supernatural entities and reveal what cannot normally be seen, and survive with limited resources and tactical combat.

Listen to the signal. Face what lies beyond the veil.

Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles - Colossal Update & DLC Reveal Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/bulwark-falconeer-chronicles/

Bulwark builders, a colossal update launches today on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5, alongside 2 new DLC's!

Shape your settlement with curved walls, take to the seas with any ship of your choosing and MORE in this free update!

Furthermore, if you wanted to add a touch of high fantasy to your settlement, the Medieval Houses DLC offers 6 different timber-clad houses to create a whole new look for your city.

On a dangerous and exciting note, the Verne Bannerless DLC introduces the units inhabiting the edge of the Ursee. The mighty Verne and Piranha units - aggressive and hostile, a great addition to your fleet.

New buildings. New weapons. New ways to shape and defend your world. Out today.
